properties.Observation: Anicut is in good condition. The total length of canal is 1Km. Although some parts of the canal that have been concrete exist remain as an earthen canal. (W=0.45m and, H=0.45m). 8 Acres of paddy is cultivated from this canal. Leakages are observed (along the canal).
